# Time-zone meeting planner

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/meeting-planner/

Compare a chosen meeting time across IANA time zones. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Set a meeting in Asia/Kathmandu and compare the same instant in London, Sydney and New York.

## Limits and checks

Daylight-saving offsets depend on the selected date. A nonexistent or ambiguous local clock time needs your attention before scheduling.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
